title: Retargeting & Exclusions
objectives: Structure an e-commerce retargeting funnel with segmented recency windows
Apply strict exclusions to stop wasting budget on past purchasers
Match ad messaging to the specific stage of customer consideration

blocks.text: Over 95% of first-time website visitors leave without buying. Retargeting brings them back to finish the purchase!
Retargeting shows customized ads specifically to people who already browsed your catalog or added items to cart.

blocks.title: The Golden Retargeting Funnel
items: Hot BOFU (0-7 Days): Cart abandoners → Address objections, offer free shipping / 10% code
Warm MOFU (8-30 Days): Website visitors & social engagers → Showcase customer reviews, media coverage, unboxing videos

blocks.title: The Sweet Shop Customer
blocks.text: If a customer already bought a box of sweets and is walking out the door, you don't chase them shouting: 'Buy sweets!' You let them enjoy it, and retarget them with a festive refill offer 30 days later.
In Indian e-commerce, offering Cash on Delivery (COD) with OTP confirmation or 1-click UPI checkout in retargeting ads recovers up to 40% of abandoned carts.
Keep retargeting budgets modest: typically 15% to 25% of total spend. If you over-fund retargeting, frequency will skyrocket to 8+ and annoy warm leads.

quiz.q: Why is it mandatory to exclude recent 30-day purchasers from cold prospecting and cart abandoner ad sets?
options: To prevent burning ad rupees showing introductory discount ads to people who already bought
Meta bans accounts that retarget buyers
quiz.explain: Excluding recent buyers protects your margins and prevents annoying loyal customers with irrelevant first-time buyer ads.

quiz.q: What ad creative angle works best for hot 0-7 day cart abandoners?
options: A generic educational video introducing what your brand is
Overcoming checkout objections: customer testimonials, trust badges, and an exclusive limited-time coupon or free shipping offer
A black and white image of your factory
A stock photo of an airplane
quiz.explain: Cart abandoners already want the product; they just need trust reinforcement or an incentive to complete checkout.

quiz.q: Approximately what percentage of a brand's total ad budget should typically be allocated to warm retargeting?
quiz.explain: Retargeting pools are finite. Dedicating 15-25% covers warm audiences while leaving 75-85% for cold customer acquisition.

quiz.q: True or False: A 3-day cart abandoner is generally more likely to convert than a 60-day cart abandoner.
quiz.explain: True! Recency is the strongest predictor of conversion intent in retargeting funnels.

recap: Segment retargeting by recency (0-7 hot vs 8-30 warm) and always exclude recent buyers.
Allocate 15-25% of total budget to retargeting to maintain healthy frequency without saturation.
